ONLY THE TREE, no scenery, no sky, no landscape, no ground tile, no grass patch, no fence, no people, no UI. Large clear continuous lower trunk, nearly vertical trunk sides, wide enough for a human to rest a shoulder against either side; preserve readable tree silhouette. Trunk centered x96, lower trunk visible roughly y100 through y174, base at y180; canopy upper half broad, natural asymmetry, avoid decorative background frame. Native crisp small pixel clusters, warm selective outlines, restrained earthy palette. The tree should look beautiful, familiar and lived-in, natural cozy game prop.
